name: Productboard
description: Productboard's hosted server lets the agent read customer insights, features and roadmaps, so product work starts from what users actually asked for.

probe.note: Answers an unauthenticated initialize with 401 and publishes OAuth metadata; the authorization server (mcp.productboard.com) offers dynamic client registration, so a harness can sign in without a pre-registered app. The sign-in itself was not completed by this check.
